$comment: languages-world-2 (11 November 2026): the WhatsApp allergen guard’s trigger words for FILIPINO (fil-PH): allergy / allergic / alerdyi / alerhiya (matched inside the infixed and reduplicated forms nagkaka-allergy, naaallergic), intolerant, celiac, sensitibo, gluten free, walang <allergen> (walang gatas, walang mani…), huwag/wag lagyan, (paki)tanggal / alisin, bawal sa akin / bawal ako, hindi ako pwede sa, hindi ako makakain, ligtas ba / ligtas para, safe ba / para, angkop para, may halong, naglalaman, kontaminasyon, bakas ng, nagkakapantal / namamantal. English safety words are matched too. Bare walang is NOT a stem (walang problema, walang pila), nor tanggap (tumatanggap = do you accept [card]), nor pantal (inside pantalon). OPTION B, as every other language: absence / safety words only, NOT the bare allergen names (a presence question may reach the AI, which answers only from the tags and gets the caveat). Matched with the Unicode normaliser. caveatWords: a tagged label of the codex allergen set (stored in English, lower case) → the words a reply may use for it (matched on the raw lower-cased reply, so written as the AI writes them). The country has no allergen set of its own yet, so caveatWords are for 'codex' (as MX, SG, HK, MY, TH and AE).
